pitch.heading: Your land, your way — on the high ground near the lake.
pitch.body:
Every tract at Sugar Tree Vista sits on a meadow ridgeline with long views over the Tennessee hills. The lots are a mix of open meadow and mature woods, with wide road frontage on each one so your nearest neighbor is never on top of you. Build a cabin, set up an RV, run trails, or just hold a beautiful piece of Tennessee.

And these aren't raw squares on a map. Graded driveways are already in, and every lot comes with a soil map marking approved septic locations — so you can take it straight to the county and pull a permit. Unrestricted. No crowds. Just space, privacy, and a view you won't get tired of.

steps.label: STEP 01
steps.heading: Book your showing
steps.body: Call, text, or email david@alot.land to lock in a private appointment. The earliest showings see the most lots available.

steps.label: STEP 02
steps.heading: Walk the land with me
steps.body: We'll tour the tracts together. You'll see the views, the road frontage, and the boundaries — everything you need to decide with confidence.

steps.label: STEP 03
steps.heading: Reserve & close
steps.body: Found your lot? Reserve it on the spot. We handle the survey, title, and paperwork, and walk you through to closing.

lots.eyebrow: Only Ten Tracts to Choose From
lots.heading: Pick Your View
lots.note: Tap any lot for photos, acreage, price, and full details.
lots.footnote: Lots are reserved on a first-come, first-served basis by private showing. Prices subject to change without notice.

developer.heading: Alot Of Land LLC
developer.tagline: Fewer, better tracts — chosen for beauty first.
developer.body:
Alot Of Land LLC, founded by David A. Stone, finds and improves standout acreage across Middle Tennessee. We're selective on purpose — we'd rather develop one extraordinary property the right way than push volume.

When you buy at Sugar Tree Vista, the hard parts are already handled: a fresh survey, clear title, and a clean, honest closing.
developer.quote: Don't wait to buy land. Buy land and wait.

lotMap.heading: See Every Lot on the Map
lotMap.body: Each pin is a homesite — click one for acreage, price, and current availability.
lotMap.placeholder: Call or text for exact lot locations and directions.

gallery.heading: Property Photos
gallery.body: Beauty comes first for us. See the ridgelines, the meadows, the road frontage, and the lake country just minutes away.

flyBuy.heading: $1,500 Fly & Buy Credit
flyBuy.body: Coming from out of state? Fly in to walk the land, and when you buy a lot we'll credit up to $1,500 of your travel — flights and hotel — toward the purchase price.
flyBuy.terms: Credit applies only with the purchase of a lot and is applied to the lot price. Not redeemable for cash. One credit per transaction. Proof of travel required.

explore.heading: Everything to Do, All Around You
explore.body: Click a pin for the full listing, one-click directions, and Street View. From the closest boat launch to Kentucky Lake day-trips, here's what's waiting just outside your gate.

guideCta.heading: Get the Sugar Tree Vista Area Guide
guideCta.body: Drive times, things to do, the lake, and what makes this corner of Tennessee special — in one PDF.

location.heading: Tennessee's big backyard — in the path of growth.
location.body: Sugar Tree Vista sits in the highlands of Decatur County — off Ray Miller Rd & Low Gap Rd, Sugar Tree, TN 38380 — on the ridgelines near the Tennessee River where it widens into Kentucky Lake, one of the largest lakes east of the Mississippi. This is small-town Tennessee at its best: quiet roads, real neighbors, and natural beauty in every direction.

drives.place: The Ponderosa boat launch — Tennessee River / Kentucky Lake

final.heading: Come see it before someone else does.
final.body: Only ten lots, reserved first come, first served by private showing. The earliest appointments get the pick of the views.

financing.heading: Financing
financing.body: Cash buyers get 10% off the price. Owner financing is available on select terms — handled directly with David, case by case — and a land loan or your own lender works too.

videos.heading: Sugar Tree Vista on Video
videos.body: Walk the ridgeline with me — updates from the field as the lots came together.

hero.heading: Sugar Tree Vista
hero.sub: Ten ridgeline meadow-view tracts near the Tennessee River at Kentucky Lake. Wide road frontage, deep privacy, and views that go on for miles.
hero.promoPill: $1,500 Fly & Buy Credit — we cover your flight and hotel, up to $1,500 off the price of the lot you buy.

guide.name: David A. Stone
guide.body: I've spent my whole career around land — in the land and homebuilding business since my teens, building and selling for the better part of two decades, and now finding and improving the kind of acreage I'd want to own myself. Sugar Tree Vista is exactly that: high, private ground with views I couldn't walk away from. Whether you're looking for a weekend retreat, a place to build, a homestead, or a smart piece of land to hold, I'll walk every lot with you and tell you straight what each one is best for. No pressure — just an honest look at the property and your options. Why I do this: I do it for my family — my wife and two young sons. I want them to look up to me as a businessman and an entrepreneur, someone who does real things with his life. And I want to provide for my family while helping other families provide for theirs, through owning land.

options.heading: Two Easy Ways to Start
options.showingBody: Showings are held on our one-day sale Saturdays. Lots go first come, first served — the earliest slots get the best pick.
options.consultBody: Prefer to talk first? Get pricing, lot details, and maps over the phone or a quick Zoom.
